description: Deadlock-free producer-consumer module with resource hierarchy. Uses priority ordering on buffer and mutex resources to guarantee deadlock freedom.

atoms.name: produce
atoms.description: Produce an item into the buffer. Acquires mutex (priority 1) before buffer (priority 2) to prevent deadlock. Returns new buffer length.

atoms.name: consume
atoms.description: Consume an item from the buffer. Acquires mutex (priority 1) before buffer (priority 2) to prevent deadlock. Returns new buffer length.

atoms.name: buffer_available
atoms.description: Check if space is available in the buffer for production (returns 1 if available, 0 otherwise).
atoms.ensures: result >= 0 && result <= 1 && (buf_len < buf_cap => result == 1) && (buf_len == buf_cap => result == 0)

atoms.name: buffer_has_items
atoms.description: Check if the buffer has items available for consumption (returns 1 if non-empty, 0 otherwise).
